about: Cartoons of Appu making one mistake (ui/teach-munni.js, Teach Appu). Keyed by the mistake's id (content/teach.js TEACH_ACTS). When Appu's mistake has a clip, his sum becomes the clip's sum (a op b), the clip stops at `pause` (the second his 'is that right?' ends) while the child taps an answer, then carries on with the fix and ends on the question the mic answers. A clip with `child` says that child's name and plays only for the child whose first name it is, in the clip's own language; without `child` it plays for anyone in `lang`. See video/SCRIPTS.md.
